items.description: Nearly 31% (318.96 km) of Andhra Pradesh’s coastline is eroding, with about 91.6 km falling into the ‘high erosion’ category. While the losses are concentrated in the delta districts of Kakinada, West Godavari, and Krishna, the coastal port district of Visakhapatnam is also facing the issue. Paul Nicodemus explores how decades of port development, changing wave patterns, and cyclones have contributed to the erosion of the City of Destiny’s beaches

items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: Nestled in the idyllic Cotswolds, a beautifully renovated stone barn is now up for sale, once serving as a tranquil weekend escape for the renowned dressmaker to Queen Elizabeth II, Hardy Amies. This charming four-bedroom residence showcases a blend of vintage charm and contemporary comforts, featuring spacious living areas, a generous garden, and breathtaking countryside vistas. The asking price stands at £1.5 million, slightly lower than its prior purchase.
